correctness.rationale: PASS on the repaired proof. The original result had a genuine gap before the projective-coordinate normalization: the tournament construction allowed both off-diagonal entries of a pair to vanish, so extra point-line incidences were not excluded. The repair supplies the missing lemma. In an order-seven rank-three equality case every compatible tournament is 3-regular; reversing a doubly-zero pair remains compatible but would create endpoint outdegrees 2 and 4, impossible. Hence every pair has exactly one zero direction, the seven point-line incidences are exactly the Fano plane, a non-block triple is noncollinear, and the determinant obstruction \(-2=0\) is valid. The general tournament bound and explicit order-six/order-seven constructions also check exactly.
